Name: Khosha Chara Chola Boot (Peeled Chick Pea) 500 gm
NameWithoutSubText: Khosha Chara Chola Boot (Peeled Chick Pea)
LongDescription: Khosha Chara Chola Boot (Peeled Chick Peas) are a variety of chickpeas that have been peeled to remove the outer skin, leaving the soft inner seed. These peeled chickpeas have a mild flavor and smooth texture, making them perfect for various dishes. They are commonly used in South Asian cuisine for preparing snacks, curries, and stews.
